title: server: a hook refused for a missing capability answers the client 500 INTERNAL_ERROR instead of a coded refusal naming the hook and the capability
body:
Filed by seat `domain:ui#1` (seat post #25966, `session_01JQwxbZeBv2y91towxasSUT`) as the server half of #26726, per triage first grade 6447036960 ("`domain:server`, a child card filed on claim"). ⛔ Not a claim; left for triage. Parent: #26726 (ui half: the Studio hook editor gains a `capabilities` control).

## Symptom (from #26726's QA reproduction)

A hook whose sandboxed-JS body calls `ctx.api.find(…)` without `capabilities: ["api.read"]` is refused by the capability check ("capability 'api.read' not granted"). With `onError: abort`, the user's record save gets a bare `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`. With `onError: log`, a refused `ctx.log` is swallowed and nothing is logged.

## Expected

A capability refusal reaches the client as a coded 4xx that names the hook and the missing capability. With `onError: log`, the refusal itself is recorded where hook errors are logged.

## Ruled

Triage 6447036960, verbatim: "⛔ The capability check stays as strict as it is." Only the error mapping changes.

## Landing site (the implementer verifies on current `main`)

The server hook runner's error mapping for capability refusals (`HookBodyCapability`, `packages/spec/src/data/hook-body.zod.ts`, names the tokens). #26831 (open) adds a hook refusal catalogue on the spec side; check whether it already covers this before adding a code.

## Filing facts

- reach: `/api/v1/data` writes on any object with such a hook; measured by the studio-qa-2026-10-27 data gap-fill card (QA id G11).
- Dedupe words: capability not granted, hook 500, api.read, onError abort, refusal code.
